title: Machine Learning (ML) Engineer
description:
Sanderson are working with a growing SaaS organisation looking to appoint an ML Engineer to join its expanding AI team.

This is a hands-on machine learning engineering opportunity, working across the development and improvement of AI agents and language models. You'll work closely with the existing engineering team and researchers, taking ideas and research through to practical implementation and production.

This is a genuine machine learning role rather than simply integrating third-party AI models. The focus is on understanding how models work, applying machine learning techniques to improve their performance and finding ways to make AI agents more accurate, consistent and effective.

What you'll be responsible for

  • Designing, building and improving AI agents, language models and the systems that support them.

  • Translating research outputs and theoretical concepts into practical, production-ready solutions.

  • Applying machine learning techniques to improve model performance, accuracy and reliability.

  • Working across the different components of an AI agent's request cycle.

  • Designing and running experiments, using measurable criteria to evaluate improvements.

  • Exploring research papers and new techniques to identify opportunities to improve the technology.

What we're looking for

We're keen to speak with engineers who have a strong foundation in machine learning and the software engineering skills to turn ideas into working products.

You'll ideally bring:

  • A background in Data Science, Machine Learning or a related discipline, combined with strong software engineering ability.

  • Commercial experience building and delivering machine learning or AI systems.

  • Practical experience working with language models and improving their behaviour and performance.

  • A good understanding of machine learning fundamentals, model evaluation and meaningful performance metrics.

  • The ability to understand research papers and translate relevant concepts into practical engineering solutions.

  • Experience with experimentation, automated testing, code reviews and version control.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and make evidence-based decisions.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity, exploring new ideas and solving complex technical problems.

This is a great opportunity to join a growing SaaS organisation where machine learning is central to the product, working on genuine AI and model engineering challenges rather than simply integrating existing tools and services.

The role offers a salary of up to £100,000 (DOE) and requires four days per week onsite.

Interested? Apply now, or contact for more information
